cover.coreProposition: Detached work must remain part of parent workflow terminal truth until it reaches a governed terminal state or its ownership is explicitly transferred; foreground return and static-graph completion are not sufficient terminal evidence.
cover.visualMetaphor: One foreground path reaches a gate while a second amber orbit remains connected and unfinished
cover.semanticObject: A terminal gate linked to two owned paths, with one still visibly active
cover.compositionIntent: Landscape editorial cover with restrained connected arcs, a strong terminal gate and generous negative space
